question: Grupo Industrial Batellero manufacturer company profile
markdown:
Grupo Industrial Batellero S.A. de C.V.
is
a Mexican manufacturing and processing company based in Uruapan, Michoacán, with operational ties to Guadalajara, Jalisco
. Established in the late 1990s/early 2010s, it specializes in producing gourmet food items, personal care goods, and bulk exports derived from locally grown Hass avocados
Verified Market Research
Core Overview
Company Name:
Grupo Industrial Batellero S.A. de C.V.
Headquarters:
Uruapan, Michoacán, Mexico (with regional presence in Guadalajara, Jalisco)
Primary Industry:
Food and Beverage Manufacturing / Vegetable Oils
Core Focus:
Extraction, refinement, and commercialization of avocado oil and derivative goods
Verified Market Research
Key Operations & Products
Avocado Oil Production:
Processes domestic Hass avocados into high smoke-point culinary oils, spanning both refined and virgin/gourmet grades.
Verified Market Research
Market Segments:
Supplies products tailored for both the global food/retail sector (cooking oils, condiments) and cosmetic/personal care formulations.
Verified Market Research
Supply Chain & Export:
Leverages Mexico's high-volume avocado yield to distribute goods internationally to markets including North America and Europe.
